title: AI Product Engineer
description:
Looking for an AI Product Engineer (Please send your CV and apply only if you have the relevant skills. Candidates who share their CV will be prioritized.)

Workload: full-time

ABOUT THE COMPANY
A legal tech company that uses AI agents to recover small claims of up to EUR 25k. It has handled over 5,000 cases for more than 500 Danish customers, raised EUR 2M from Vendep Capital, and is now growing across Europe. Tech stack: Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP, Next.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google.

REQUIREMENTS
- At least 3 years of experience building and running software in production
- Solid backend skills: background jobs, authentication and authorization models, API design
- Postgres/SQL expertise: schema design, migrations, query performance
- Hands-on experience with LLMs in production: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, and protection against prompt injection
- Uses AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, or similar) every day
- Treats testing as standard practice: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, a staging-to-production release flow
- Cloud and deployment experience: AWS or a similar provider, Docker, CI/CD

BONUS POINTS
- Specific experience with Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js
- Has run production migrations, data backfills, or major-version upgrades
- Practical AWS skills (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux
- Experience with eval and observability tools for agentic workflows
- Has built integrations with systems that lack documented APIs (webhooks, scraping, browser extensions)
- Background in legal tech, fintech, or another regulated industry

PERSONAL QUALITIES
Thinks like a product owner, takes ownership of work from start to finish, communicates directly, is comfortable working with end users (lawyers, case managers), and is interested in the legal field.

HIRING PROCESS
Introduction with CV, GitHub, and links to shipped work -> skills self-assessment and written questions -> interviews with the team -> offer.
